name: connexion-ide
description: Local Zaalis IDE with an Express server, CLI, and native macOS shell (Electron).

scripts.build:rust:x64: cargo build --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --workspace --release --target x86_64-apple-darwin && sh scripts/stage-rust-binaries.sh native/dist-macos-x64-server
scripts.build:rust:arm64: cargo build --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --workspace --release --target aarch64-apple-darwin && sh scripts/stage-rust-binaries.sh native/dist-macos-arm64-server
scripts.build:cli: cargo build --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --release -p zaalis-cli -p zaalis-agentd -p zaalis-sandbox-helper && sh scripts/stage-rust-binaries.sh
